findings.proposedFix: change-log-level: pin logging.getLogger('botocore')/('boto3')/('urllib3') to WARNING in setup_logging()
findings.what: boto3.resource() called with explicit aws_access_key_id / aws_secret_access_key
findings.whySensitive: boto3/botocore loggers can emit request signing detail at DEBUG; repo sets root logger to DEBUG so a stray boto3 DEBUG could expose credential-adjacent data

findings.proposedFix: change-log-level: set FileHandler to INFO and/or add a repo-side logging.Filter scrubbing config dicts and exception text (overlaps file-writes:65)
findings.what: Root logger DEBUG; FileHandler DEBUG -> timestamped log file; no repo-side scrubbing filter
findings.whySensitive: DEBUG file logs aggregate detailed records; repo relies entirely on almaapitk 0.4.5 redaction with no own filter
